label: GO step in the last ~10 trials of the episode, after a reward, when choosing a2
explanation: Fires only at GO and only in the final trials of an episode: all activations fall at ep_trial >= 80 and 99% at >= 90, which matches the lowest value-head bin (value < 5.22, i.e. little reward left in the episode). Within that window it prefers trials where the previous trial was rewarded (96% of mass) and where the agent picks a2 (95% of mass; strongly negative choice logit). The a2 condition uses the agent own upcoming GO choice, which is marked FUTURE but is something the agent computes itself; no unknowable random outcome is used. Replacing it with the observed policy logit (choice < -4) gives about the same score (F1 0.75 vs 0.76). Magnitude rises toward the episode end: trials 95-99 have 39% of activations but 62% of mass, and the predicate restricted to them has 0.97 precision. Never fires at D1 or D2, and never before trial 80. It is weak and rare on a1 choices and after unrewarded trials. Dev: P 0.79, R 0.74, F1 0.76, mass recall 0.90. Misses are mostly weak activations on a1 or after no reward. False positives are mostly around trial 90 or are a2 choices with a weak logit. This is best read as an end-of-episode timer gated by a recent reward and an a2 policy.
